description: A records-office press, older than the bank ones and prouder about it. Decommissioned, and clearly by somebody who loved it: the housing has been wiped down, the cover is a proper fitted one rather than a bin liner, and the hand-lettered card is still taped to the front. A CARD IS A RECORD. THE RECORD IS PERMANENT. Somebody has added, in pen, SO ARE YOU, and somebody later still has added, in pencil, MOVED TO IRONSIDE. ASK FOR EMMETT.
name: archival mint press
